description: Frequently asked questions about Northwest Meditation Center retreats.
introduction: A few practical details to help you prepare for a retreat.
emptyMessage: More answers will be added soon.

questions.question: Who can attend a retreat?
questions.answer: Retreats are open to anyone interested in learning about the Theravada Buddhist tradition. No prior meditation experience is needed.

questions.question: Do I need to register?
questions.answer: Yes. Please contact the center before attending so we can share arrival information and prepare for your visit.

questions.question: What happens during a retreat?
questions.answer: The schedule includes periods of meditation, Dhamma teachings, meals, and time for rest and reflection.

questions.question: Are meals or overnight accommodation provided?
questions.answer: Simple vegetarian meals and shared accommodation are available during retreats.

questions.question: What should I bring or wear?
questions.answer: Wear comfortable, modest clothing and bring personal toiletries, a water bottle, and any medication you need.

questions.question: Is there a fee?
questions.answer: Retreats are offered on a donation basis. Donations help cover food, lodging, and center expenses.
